info.name: Reonic REST Api v3 Activities Upload API

items.docs:
Returns an `uploadUrl` plus an `uploadId` you can later pass to a registration endpoint.

Upload your file with a single `PUT` request to `uploadUrl`, sending the raw file bytes as the request body and a `Content-Type` header that matches the file. Do not use `multipart/form-data`. The URL stops accepting uploads after `expiresAt` (1 hour after creation).

Once the upload completes, reference `uploadId` from a registration endpoint — for example `POST /files/create`.

**Allowed API keys:** Read
